title: [Bug] Claude Code ignores `"attribution": false` in settings.json
body:

top_comments.author: ltawfik
top_comments.body:
the correct syntax is either:
    - "attribution": { "commit": "", "pr": "" } (new setting - to hide attribution)
    - "includeCoAuthoredBy": false (deprecated but still works)
